system_prompt_sha256_note: The same SYSTEM_PROMPT is defined for every configuration.
system_prompt: You are a coding agent answering a question about one repository snapshot. Use only the tools that are available. Cite repository evidence for every code claim. If the tools do not contain enough evidence, answer exactly: unknown. Do not invent files, symbols, or test results.

no_graph.description: File list and file read only. No code-graph query tool.

original_graphify.description: Same prompt and file tools, plus query_graph implemented by unmodified upstream Graphify with no Synapse flags.

synapse_default.description: Synapse query_graph using default weighted traversal. Personalized PageRank, learned weights, and community-aware retrieval are off.

synapse_full.description: Synapse query_graph with community-aware retrieval, learned weights, and Personalized PageRank. PageRank replaces neighborhood ranking, so this is not the community walk plus PageRank.

token_estimate: Retrieved context uses len(text)//4 from graphify's local estimator. It is not a provider token count.
